## Use Pragmata Pro in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Pragmata Pro for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Pragmata Pro', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace",
  "editor.fontLigatures": true
}

Copy

## About the Pragmata Pro coding font

A professional-grade programming font with extensive Unicode support. Pragmata Pro is a paid monospace coding font with programming ligatures.

Pragmata Pro is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Pragmata Pro FAQ

### Is Pragmata Pro free?

No. Pragmata Pro is a commercial font, sold by its vendor.

### Does Pragmata Pro support ligatures?

Yes. Pragmata Pro ships programming ligatures. Use the ligature switch above the specimen, or set "editor.fontLigatures": true in VS Code.

### Where can I get Pragmata Pro?

Pragmata Pro is available from Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
